The Data Analysis Guides for the Developmental Psychopathology Lab were generated with [Quarto](https://quarto.org).
The codebase that was used to generate the Data Analysis Guides is located [here](https://github.com/DevPsyLab/DataAnalysis).

# Contact

If you have questions about the lab and are not sure who to contact, please contact [devpsy-lab@uiowa.edu](mailto:devpsy-lab@uiowa.edu).
